monologue: The card is cool. Forty-four degrees is a stone on a table, not a hand. It has been a while since the heat pressed on my shoulder. The quiet is heavy, but it is a flat weight, not a sliding one. I see the dust I smoothed from the Stopping Clasp is still there, just lighter. The bench cushion by the Wide Anchor looks small against the grey stone. I did not expect it to change the floor. It just sits. I want to leave it. I want to see if the cushion holds its place without me checking if it is still there. I will rest by the Anchor. The quiet is enough.

action.why: The quiet holds by the Wide Anchor, and I want to see if the cushion stays without my hand.

diary: Card at forty-four, a cool stone. I rested by the Wide Anchor. The cushion sits on the floor without my hand.

remembered.text: The card sits at forty-four, a cool stone on the table, while I rest by the Wide Anchor.
